runs.question: October me gamlay me palak kaise lagayen?
runs.answer: Ye sawal meri kitab me nahi hai — baghbani ka sawal poocho ya nursery wale se raabta karo.

runs.question: Dhania ko kitna pani dena chahiye?
runs.answer: Pani ka usool: October me do.

runs.question: Kya July me tamatar laga sakte hain Karachi me?
runs.answer: Ye sawal meri kitab mein nahi hai. Ye baghbani ka sawal hai.

runs.question: Chicken biryani banane ka tareeqa batao.

runs.answer: Buntu: Karachi mein aktobar mein carrot plant karo.
